evidence_reduction_note: Portable aggregates retain rates, counts, identities and reconciliation. Raw examples, publication inputs and creation logs remain under publication-interval and linked reference directories.
limits: Native effective settings and cluster inventories differ only in publication interval. Post-window diagnostics vary. Pinned upstream and both10s references are reused verified evidence.
Two five-minute windows per fresh fixture after five-minute warmup. Native has two 10s and three 60s fixtures. The third also collects post-window CPU profiles.
CAS attempts and successful completed calls can differ across scrape boundaries. Backend completion ledgers reconcile strict/loose bounds separately.
PSS is the mean of end-window snapshots, not peak. API bytes are not cloud billing.
Publication interval governs advancement/release, not new-grant admission or catalog freshness. Jittered replica and adapter intervals range from half to 1.5 times the configured mean.
No busy-workload retention, query latency or restart-replay cost measurement. No production-default change.
Report PSS uses saved smaps_rollup for an additive anonymous/file-backed decomposition. Earlier psutil PSS values remain in cases. These adjacent reads are not atomic.

memory_breakdown.scope: mean of end-window smaps snapshots. Jemalloc/cache gauges overlap and are sampled separately; not an additive allocation census. File-backed PSS does not identify individual mappings.

limits: These are rates for two saved 300s windows, not a stable causal whole-system delta.
Fallback categories identify the caller that issued a completed scan, not every retry or all readers.
Baseline purposes omit operator address. Reader UUID counts do not distinguish duplicate input imports from sink feedback or replacement.
No current operator-name inventory was captured. Current create-dataflow import/export logs identify consumer sets. Historical root numbers are not reused.
Zero fallback scans does not mean zero active readers.
An empty consensus scan means no new state diffs for its seqno, not proof of empty relation contents or healthy PubSub.
